claims.text: Gazette No. 20 of Monday 11 September 2006 carries Prime Minister Feleti Vaka'uta Sevele's announcement that the passing away of His Majesty King Taufa'ahau Tupou IV occurred in Auckland, New Zealand, 'at 11:34 pm on 10th September 2006 (New Zealand time), 12:34 am on 11th September 2006, (Tongan time)'.
claims.locator: Reproduced gazette header and first paragraph; article timestamp Sep 11, 2006, 18:32
claims.uncertainty: attested_on is the Tongan calendar date, as for George Tupou V's death, which is recorded in Tonga time; the New Zealand date, 10 September, is kept in printed_times and is the date the UN record gives (to_crown_tupou_iv_death_20060910_un). The two printed times are one instant, consistent with New Zealand standard time (UTC+12) and Tongan time (UTC+13) in September 2006. PMO web reproduction, not the gazette facsimile.

claims.text: The same notice announces that the late King will arrive in Tonga by Royal New Zealand Air Force flight on Wednesday 13 September 2006 and lie in state at the Royal Palace, and that the State Funeral will be at the Mala'e Kula Royal Tombs on Tuesday 19 September 2006.
claims.uncertainty: An advance announcement, dated by the notice. The burial is reported separately after the event (to_crown_tupou_iv_burial_reported_20060920). A funeral is not a reign boundary.

claims.text: The notice declares a period of State mourning of one month, beginning 'today' and ending on 17 October 2006, with flags flown at half-mast throughout the Kingdom.
claims.uncertainty: A mourning instrument, separate from the death, the accession and the proclamation; not a reign boundary.
